letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter because it whispers your name, and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad carries the scent of our shared laughter. I’m still amazed that on that golden February day in 2025 we promised forever, and now every moment with you feels like a beautiful adventure. You’re my cutie, my confidante, my endless source of joy. Thank you for turning ordinary days into magical memories—my heart beats only for you, today and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or river’s gleam,  
Your love’s the light within my dream.  
Across the miles, our hearts align,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
